olga_eval: quick flag — during nebula-v2 int8 bring-up I noticed a weird detok + bracket/mirror flip for mixed RTL+CJK inputs. BLEU (ar/zh->en) down ~1.9 on loc-multitest. sample below.

rashid_loc: paste the sample + config?

olga_eval: run 2026-05-11-nebulav2-int8-bracket. model: nebula-v2, quant=int8 per-channel asymmetric, kernels=auto, tokenizer v2026-04-30. evalset: loc-multitest (1.6k pairs). example:
```
input (ar+zh): "[\u0627\u0644\u0628\u0631\u0646\u0627\u0645\u062c]\u4f8b\u5b50"
fp16 output: "[The program] example"
int8 output: "]elpmaxe[ The program"
// got bracket mirrored and token order swapped around localized bracket pair
```

ben_infra: whoa — looks like bidi reordering / detok postprocess messed up. tokenizer roundtrip on input ok? any differences in token ids?

olga_eval: token ids match pre/post on inputs. issue appears only in generation/detok. reproduced on GPU and CPU shards. toggling `--force-fp16-kv` improved but didn't fully fix — bracket still mirrored in some cases.

sara_product: is this specific to brackets or any paired punctuation? customer reports for Arabic+Japanese UI strings could be affected.

olga_eval: we see it mostly on paired punctuation (brackets, angled quotes) when adjacent to short CJK tokens. hypothesis: small logit shifts cause the model to emit mirrored punctuation + reordering during BIDI-aware detok.

ben_infra: try forcing `RT_KV_FP16=true` and also disable detok-bidi poststep to narrow it down (`--no-bidi-detok`). if disabling poststep fixes it, detok code might be assuming stable token spacing.

olga_eval: ran with `RT_KV_FP16=true --no-bidi-detok`. result: detok mirror gone for sample, BLEU improved to -0.3. so both kv numerics and detok logic contribute. attaching kv dumps and detok logs to ticket NEBULA-INT8-121.

rashid_loc: thanks. i'll add unit cases around paired punctuation + mixed-orientation runs to the fuzz harness. also propose adding a temporary Optimize rule: for datasets tagged with rtl+east_asian, recommend `kv_fp16=true` and enable stricter bidi-detok checks.

ci-bot: CI job triggered NEBULA-INT8-121 (#4020) on eng-ml/nebula-v2-int8 (builders x3). logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4020

sara_product: let's hold int8 canary for localization customers until kernel + detok patch lands. document impact in the release notes.

olga_eval: will follow up in the issue with samples and a PR for the fuzz cases. :white_check_mark:
